I want you to help me create two separate three-year step by step plan that will lead to me publishing a cook book. 

I want one plan to be a traditional route to publishing and the other one a self-publishing route.

I post cooking videos on this channel (link to channel). These are the recipes I would like featured in the cookbook. Prioritise recipes from videos that perform the best.

I only have a maximum of three days a week to donate to this project as I work four days.
